scope: Local code and isolated synthetic fixtures; no full-book listening or production load/security testing. Findings include defects and explicit risk/quality gaps. Existing published recordings were not regenerated.

findings.title: Semantic footnotes become exponents
findings.evidence: An epub:type=noteref superscript 2 becomes “squared” before note removal.
findings.fix: Remove semantic note markers before interpreting mathematical superscripts.

findings.title: Literal bracketed numbers are deleted
findings.evidence: values[1] becomes values; a general footnote regex removes meaningful notation.
findings.fix: Remove references using markup and preserve ambiguous literal brackets.

findings.title: Ruby annotations are read twice
findings.evidence: Base text and ruby pronunciation concatenate into one spoken string.
findings.fix: Choose the pronunciation or base text explicitly; do not concatenate both.

findings.title: Hidden draft text enters narration
findings.evidence: A paragraph with the hidden attribute is retained.
findings.fix: Respect hidden content and define a conservative CSS visibility policy.

findings.title: Tracked deletions and insertions are both read
findings.evidence: del and ins produce Old version.New version.
findings.fix: Choose a documented revision policy and keep sentence boundaries.

findings.title: Meaningful image alternative text disappears
findings.evidence: The sign read an image with alt KEEP OUT becomes The sign read .
findings.fix: Preserve meaningful alt text while excluding decorative images.

findings.title: Nonlinear spine entries join the story
findings.evidence: A linear=no answer key is appended to the selected chapter.
findings.fix: Keep supplemental spine material separately selectable.

findings.title: Missing required EPUB files are silently skipped
findings.evidence: A missing second spine file produces a successful partial book.
findings.fix: Fail with the missing section identified, or require explicit partial conversion.

findings.title: Encoded cover filenames fail to resolve
findings.evidence: cover%20image.png does not find cover image.png in the archive.
findings.fix: Apply the same URI decoding to every EPUB resource lookup.

findings.title: Encoded navigation filenames lose chapter names
findings.evidence: nav%20page.xhtml is ignored despite the file existing with a space.
findings.fix: Decode the navigation resource path before ZIP lookup.

findings.title: Fragment-only navigation links lose section boundaries
findings.evidence: Links #one and #two in the navigation/spine document collapse into one section.
findings.fix: Resolve an empty path to the current document, not its directory.

findings.title: Invalid Roman headings are interpreted as numbers
findings.evidence: IIX becomes Chapter 10; CIVIL becomes Chapter 153.
findings.fix: Validate Roman numeral grammar and require heading context before conversion.

findings.title: Title cleanup discards meaningful prefixes
findings.evidence: Thoughts on Chapter IV becomes Chapter 4.
findings.fix: Anchor chapter-title recognition and preserve surrounding words.

findings.title: Short multi-chapter documents stay one chapter
findings.evidence: Three short h1 chapter sections without a TOC remain one section.
findings.fix: Recognize consistent chapter headings independently of the 12,000-word threshold.

observations.input: three short chapters with headings but no TOC

findings.title: Two inline TOC anchors assign text to the last chapter
findings.evidence: First and Second inside one paragraph are both assigned to entry Two.
findings.fix: Split at anchor positions, including within a text block.

observations.input: two TOC anchors in one paragraph

findings.title: Poetry line breaks lose their pacing
findings.evidence: br-separated lines become a single space-separated sentence.
findings.fix: Preserve verse line boundaries and apply a separate pause policy; listening evaluation remains needed.

actual.text: First line Second line Third line

findings.title: Short selectable PDFs are mislabeled as scans
findings.evidence: A three-word text PDF is rejected as having no selectable text.
findings.fix: Separate empty extraction from a short but valid document.

observations.actual: This PDF has no selectable text (it's probably a scan), so it can't be read aloud.

findings.title: Mixed text/scanned PDFs omit pages without warning
findings.evidence: A three-page text/empty/text fixture succeeds with no extraction warning.
findings.fix: Report pages with no extracted text and request OCR/review when appropriate; blank pages alone are not errors.

observations.input: three-page PDF, middle page has no selectable text

findings.title: PDF language metadata is ignored
findings.evidence: A PDF whose catalog Lang is fr returns language en.
findings.fix: Read document language and avoid falsely labeling unsupported languages English.

findings.title: PDF cleanup is skipped on parser errors
findings.evidence: task.destroy runs only on the success path; short-document and page errors bypass it.
findings.fix: Destroy the loading task in finally. Resource exhaustion has not been load-tested.

findings.title: Multi-column PDFs interleave unrelated sentences
findings.evidence: Row-ordered items produce Left one Right one, then Left two Right two.
findings.fix: Group columns/reading regions before joining text, and flag ambiguous layouts.

findings.title: Nested PDF chapters disappear under multiple parts
findings.evidence: Two outline parts with child chapters return only the two part entries.
findings.fix: Traverse the outline and choose the appropriate chapter level.

observations.input: two outline parts each containing two chapters

findings.title: FitR bookmark coordinates are ignored
findings.evidence: Distinct FitR rectangles on the same page are rejected as the same position.
findings.fix: Read FitR top coordinates and account for destination geometry.

observations.actual: This PDF has multiple bookmarks at the same position. Use an EPUB or a PDF with distinct chapter destinations so no section is silently skipped.

findings.title: PDF margin detection ignores page-origin offsets
findings.evidence: On a view starting at y=100, body text at y=790 is marked as margin.
findings.fix: Normalize coordinates against the view origin before margin classification.

observations.input: page view lower-left is y=100, header y=850

findings.title: Digit-only title differences trigger title-page exclusion
findings.evidence: A short Book 2 section in Book 1 is unselected because title comparison drops digits.
findings.fix: Preserve numerals in title-page matching and require stronger front-matter evidence.

observations.input: short narrative chapter title differs from book only by number

findings.title: Character limits still permit model token truncation
findings.evidence: 329 characters of repeated numbers yield 1,505 tokens, but the model receives 512.
findings.fix: Chunk after phonemization/tokenization with an explicit no-truncation assertion.

findings.title: Hard splits can break Unicode characters
findings.evidence: A supplementary character across the 380-code-unit boundary becomes two lone surrogates.
findings.fix: Split on Unicode code-point or grapheme boundaries.

findings.title: Invalid waveform samples are silently converted
findings.evidence: NaN becomes zero; infinities saturate. No invalid-sample error is raised.
findings.fix: Reject or explicitly repair non-finite audio with diagnostics before encoding.

observations.input: NaN and infinities in generated waveform

findings.title: Worker exits can strand pending requests
findings.evidence: The client handles worker error and message but not exit.
findings.fix: Reject outstanding calls on every worker exit and recreate a healthy worker.

findings.title: Inference has no deadline or recovery path
findings.evidence: Pending worker calls have no timeout; a stalled generation can hold the single queue.
findings.fix: Add bounded inference deadlines, cancellation, and worker restart.

findings.title: A failed first voice lookup stays failed
findings.evidence: voicesPromise permanently caches a rejected promise.
findings.fix: Clear the cached promise on rejection and permit retry.

findings.title: Model calls can overlap without an admission limit
findings.evidence: The async worker message listener can run multiple generate calls concurrently.
findings.fix: Serialize or explicitly bound inference concurrency; overload has not been stress-tested.

findings.title: Empty synthesized audio can be accepted as a chapter
findings.evidence: No output-length validation occurs before silence is appended and the chapter becomes done.
findings.fix: Validate nonempty finite audio per chunk and flag implausible durations.

findings.title: Encoder subprocesses have no timeout
findings.evidence: The ffmpeg promise waits indefinitely for close.
findings.fix: Apply timeouts, terminate child processes, and expose retryable errors.

findings.title: Library narration buffers a whole chapter twice
findings.evidence: The CLI retains every PCM chunk, then Buffer.concat allocates the full chapter again.
findings.fix: Stream PCM to disk with backpressure and a memory budget.

findings.title: Converter regeneration writes over the served chapter
findings.evidence: encodeChapter writes the final M4A path directly while the audio route serves any existing file.
findings.fix: Encode to a temporary file and atomically replace only after validation.

findings.title: Concurrent exports share temporary and output filenames
findings.evidence: M4B/MP3 builders use the same concat.txt and chapters.ffmeta in a book directory.
findings.fix: Use a per-book export lock, immutable inputs, and unique temporary files.

findings.title: WebP covers break M4B downloads
findings.evidence: Actual buildAudiobook fails because WebP cannot be stream-copied into the MP4 container.
findings.fix: Transcode supported cover inputs to a compatible still format before muxing.

findings.title: Whole-book export accepts an incomplete selection
findings.evidence: An export succeeds with three selected chapters but only two done.
findings.fix: Distinguish partial exports explicitly or require all selected chapters to be ready.

findings.title: PCM stream failures lack an error handler
findings.evidence: The write stream has no error listener; write/drain/end promises only resolve.
findings.fix: Handle stream errors and reject the job without crashing or hanging the server.

findings.title: Book metadata writes are non-atomic
findings.evidence: book.json is overwritten directly; a partial write is silently skipped during load.
findings.fix: Write a temporary snapshot and rename atomically; surface corrupt-book recovery.

findings.title: Done status does not verify that audio exists
findings.evidence: A chapter remains done after its audio file disappears; reload trusts metadata.
findings.fix: Reconcile completed status with valid assets during load and before download.

findings.title: Restart abandons queued work
findings.evidence: loadLibrary converts every non-done status to idle and reconstructs no queue.
findings.fix: Persist jobs and restore safe pending work after restart.

findings.title: Late cancellation can still finish the chapter
findings.evidence: Cancellation is checked before each chunk, not after the last inference or before publishing the encoded file.
findings.fix: Check cancellation before encoding and before committing output.

findings.title: Deleting a working book races with the queue
findings.evidence: deleteBook removes the directory immediately; runQueue later saves outside its chapter catch, and its promise is not awaited.
findings.fix: Wait for cancellation to settle or tombstone the book and guard all final writes.

findings.title: Concurrent starts can exceed the active-book limit
findings.evidence: The count is checked before asynchronous fingerprint reads; other books can reserve work during that gap.
findings.fix: Reserve capacity atomically and recheck after asynchronous preparation.

findings.title: Invalid chapter indexes are accepted
findings.evidence: Indexes 999 and 1.5 succeed and leave every real chapter unselected.
findings.fix: Validate unique integer indexes against the book before changing any state.

findings.title: Narration speed is not bounded or validated
findings.evidence: A speed of -2 is accepted into book settings; the route only coerces Number(speed).
findings.fix: Reject non-finite and out-of-range speeds before queueing.

findings.title: Unknown voices are accepted into jobs
findings.evidence: A nonexistent voice is accepted into book settings without membership validation.
findings.fix: Validate the voice against available model voices before changing settings.

findings.title: Disk-space checks fail open
findings.evidence: Unexpected statfs errors are swallowed by checkSpace.
findings.fix: Treat an unavailable capacity check as a retryable operational failure.

findings.title: Accepted jobs can consume the remaining disk
findings.evidence: Space is checked before work, with no reservation or checks while PCM/export files grow.
findings.fix: Reserve estimated storage and monitor capacity during generation and export.

findings.title: Failed or cancelled generation leaves PCM files
findings.evidence: PCM deletion happens only after successful encoding.
findings.fix: Remove temporary audio in finally, with a deliberate checkpoint policy.

findings.title: Partial upload writes can leave untracked directories
findings.evidence: Directories and text files are written before registration; failure can leave paths outside the books map and normal cleanup.
findings.fix: Roll back failed uploads and periodically reconcile orphan directories.

findings.title: Completed chunks cannot be resumed after interruption
findings.evidence: Only chapter-level completion is persisted; partially generated chunks have no checkpoint.
findings.fix: Checkpoint verified chunks with source/settings fingerprints.

findings.title: Missing cached exports are not rebuilt
findings.evidence: A matching built key returns audiobook.m4b even when that file does not exist.
findings.fix: Check asset existence/integrity before trusting the cached export key.

findings.title: Cancelled regeneration can leave old audio reachable
findings.evidence: Old M4A remains while metadata moves to idle/error; the audio route checks only file existence.
findings.fix: Keep published and working revisions separate and serve the declared revision.

findings.title: Private metadata and text lack explicit no-store headers
findings.evidence: Owner-protected book/text routes send responses without the policy used by voice recommendations.
findings.fix: Set private, no-store consistently. Shared-cache exposure was not demonstrated.

findings.title: Uploaded SVG covers execute same-origin script
findings.evidence: Directly opening the fixture cover runs its onload script; the route serves raw uploaded SVG.
findings.fix: Sanitize or rasterize SVG, or isolate it on a separate origin with restrictive response policy.

findings.title: EPUB decompression has no expanded-size budget
findings.evidence: The 50MB upload limit does not cap ZIP expansion, entry count, or total extracted text.
findings.fix: Enforce decompressed-byte, entry, and text budgets before full extraction.

findings.title: PDF processing has no page/work budget
findings.evidence: parsePdf reads every page with no document-level deadline or page cap.
findings.fix: Bound document complexity and move expensive extraction into cancellable workers.

findings.title: Concurrent uploads have no aggregate memory limit
findings.evidence: Multer memoryStorage buffers each request; only per-file size is limited.
findings.fix: Stream uploads and enforce concurrent request/global byte admission limits.

findings.title: EPUB parsing performs large synchronous work on the server thread
findings.evidence: XML/HTML parsing occurs in the request process after archive reads.
findings.fix: Move parsing to a bounded worker pool and measure event-loop delay on large fixtures.

findings.title: Voice-preview audio cache grows without a bound
findings.evidence: Each distinct voice/text pair stores a WAV buffer forever in a Map.
findings.fix: Use a byte-bounded LRU with expiry.

findings.title: Identical simultaneous previews duplicate inference
findings.evidence: The cache entry is added after await synthesize, with no shared pending promise.
findings.fix: Deduplicate in-flight preview requests and clear failures for retry.

findings.title: Preview requests bypass narration admission limits
findings.evidence: The preview endpoint invokes synthesis without the job-owner limit or a rate limiter.
findings.fix: Apply per-owner/global inference admission and fair scheduling to previews too.

findings.title: Startup model failure is not caught
findings.evidence: loadTts().then has no rejection handler at server startup.
findings.fix: Handle load failure, report readiness accurately, and retry or exit deliberately.

findings.title: Private feeds include deselected chapters
findings.evidence: The feed filters done status only, rather than selected and done.
findings.fix: Define the feed selection contract and honor the saved selection.

findings.title: Private episode identity omits the audio revision
findings.evidence: GUID uses book/index/voice but not speed or fingerprint; corrected audio reuses the same URL.
findings.fix: Define stable episode identity plus explicit revision/update behavior and versioned enclosure URLs.

findings.title: Public episode identities depend on list position
findings.evidence: Inserting a chapter changes the meaning of slug-number GUIDs.
findings.fix: Assign durable chapter IDs independent of array position.

findings.title: Remote-only feed audio has no enclosure length
findings.evidence: fileSize checks local disk only; the generated remote-only fixture omits length.
findings.fix: Persist byte counts in the manifest and use them for feeds; actual podcast-client failure is not claimed.

findings.title: Feed dates change if builtAt is absent
findings.evidence: Two renders one second apart produce different pubDates.
findings.fix: Require a stable publication timestamp in validated manifests.

findings.title: R2 audio URLs do not use content revisions
findings.evidence: Hash versioning applies only to explicit origin storage; R2 keys remain unchanged after replacement.
findings.fix: Publish immutable versioned R2 keys or a verified cache-purge/version strategy.

findings.title: Converter audio cache key omits the fingerprint
findings.evidence: The player URL uses voice and duration; a same-duration correction keeps the same URL.
findings.fix: Include the actual generation fingerprint in media URLs.

findings.title: Malformed ready manifests reach page rendering
findings.evidence: ready=true is accepted without a chapter/download schema; missing chapters throws in bookVars.
findings.fix: Validate manifests before publication and retain the last valid version.

findings.title: Non-atomic public manifest writes can temporarily unpublish a book
findings.evidence: The generator overwrites JSON while publishedBooks skips parse failures.
findings.fix: Publish manifest snapshots atomically and retain the previous valid manifest on read errors.

findings.title: First cover-thumbnail generation blocks requests
findings.evidence: smallCover invokes spawnSync ffmpeg during page rendering.
findings.fix: Generate thumbnails in the publication pipeline or a background job.

findings.title: Thumbnail failures are retried on every request
findings.evidence: Missing or unsupported covers cause repeated synchronous conversion attempts without a failure cache.
findings.fix: Record failures/backoff and return a safe placeholder.

findings.title: Misspelled generation targets exit successfully
findings.evidence: An unknown slug matches no books and the CLI exits zero without an error.
findings.fix: Reject unknown requested slugs and summarize selected work before starting.

findings.title: Checkbox changes do not change the download selection
findings.evidence: Unchecking a chapter leaves two checked in the UI, three selected on the server, and Download still available.
findings.fix: Persist selection separately and build downloads from that saved selection.

findings.title: The converter offers old audio as current
findings.evidence: A fixture with obsolete fingerprints still offers Download because UI freshness ignores fingerprints.
findings.fix: Expose a server-computed current/stale state and use it consistently.

findings.title: Reopening a non-default-speed book suggests unnecessary recreation
findings.evidence: A speed-2 completed book renders Recreate because client speed stays at its initial value.
findings.fix: Restore saved book speed before evaluating completion.

observations.actual:
Recreate with this voice — free

3 chapters · about <1 min of audio · 90 words

findings.title: Slow navigation can display the wrong uploaded book
findings.evidence: A delayed response for A overwrites B after the URL has changed to B.
findings.fix: Cancel stale requests or guard responses with a navigation token.

findings.title: One failed poll permanently stops job updates
findings.evidence: After one successful queued response and one 500, no more polls occur.
findings.fix: Retry transient failures with backoff and preserve the last known job state.

findings.title: A failed book-list load has no visible error
findings.evidence: A mocked /api/books 500 yields an unhandled rejection and no visible upload error.
findings.fix: Catch list-load failures and show a retry action.

findings.title: Failed cancellation has no visible error
findings.evidence: A mocked cancel 500 yields an unhandled rejection without a book error.
findings.fix: Catch cancellation failures and leave an honest retryable state.

findings.title: A stale metadata listener seeks the next chapter incorrectly
findings.evidence: Switching from delayed chapter A with a saved 10s position to B applies A's seek to B.
findings.fix: Bind seek restoration to the current source/load generation and remove obsolete listeners.

errors: The play() request was interrupted by a new load request. https://goo.gl/LdLk22

findings.title: Converter audio failure has no usable recovery message
findings.evidence: A chapter 404 rejects play but leaves the visible book-error region hidden.
findings.fix: Handle both media errors and play rejection, with retry and source diagnostics.

errors: Failed to load because no supported source was found.
Failed to load because no supported source was found.

findings.title: Corrupt saved position throws a playback exception
findings.evidence: A saved time of bad is passed to currentTime as a non-finite value.
findings.fix: Validate and clamp persisted indexes/times, discarding invalid state.

errors: Failed to set the 'currentTime' property on 'HTMLMediaElement': The provided double value is non-finite.
Failed to set the 'currentTime' property on 'HTMLMediaElement': The provided double value is non-finite.

findings.title: Autoplay ignores unchecked chapters
findings.evidence: After chapter 1 ends, unchecked chapter 2 is selected because step filters only done.
findings.fix: Use the listener's selected playlist for previous/next and auto-advance.

errors: The play() request was interrupted by a new load request. https://goo.gl/LdLk22

findings.title: Completed converter books keep a resume position at the end
findings.evidence: Ending the final chapter leaves the stored index and full duration.
findings.fix: Record completion separately and offer a clean restart.

findings.title: Late library media errors leave the error message hidden
findings.evidence: Dispatching a media error after play does not reveal the playback-error region.
findings.fix: Listen for audio error/stalled events and restore usable controls.

findings.title: Current chapter click cannot pause inside persistent navigation
findings.evidence: An embedded chapter click delegates to parent play and leaves already-playing audio running.
findings.fix: Make the current chapter action toggle play/pause consistently.

findings.title: Landing pages throw when the URL has no hash
findings.evidence: openFromHash produces false then calls false.matches; Chrome reports el?.matches is not a function.
findings.fix: Use null for no target or guard that the target is an Element.

observations.observed: el?.matches is not a function; also reproduced in cases 95, 96, 98

findings.title: An embedded book preview can play over the persistent audiobook
findings.evidence: The fixture shows parentPaused=false and childPlaying=true after starting a preview.
findings.fix: Route previews through the shared player or explicitly arbitrate parent/child audio.

findings.title: Detached voice samples bypass persistent playback coordination
findings.evidence: A new Audio voice sample plays while the parent audiobook continues; it never reaches the document play listener.
findings.fix: Use one explicit audio coordinator for detached samples and the persistent player.

findings.title: Converter navigation inside the frame leaves the address bar stale
findings.evidence: The iframe opens #/book/id while the top URL remains the homepage.
findings.fix: Synchronize route changes and browser history across the persistent shell.

findings.title: Replaying a finished homepage sample starts at the last chapter
findings.evidence: The replay path calls play on the retained last source and never resets its chapter index.
findings.fix: Define Replay book to reset to the first chapter after full completion.

findings.title: A transient sample-timing failure is cached for the page lifetime
findings.evidence: A failed timings request is replaced by an empty object and never retried.
findings.fix: Retry transient failures and cache only successful timing data.

findings.title: Converter chapter buttons announce Play while playing
findings.evidence: The playing chapter retains aria-label Play Chapter 1.
findings.fix: Update accessible labels with the actual toggle action.

findings.title: A cancelled seek gesture freezes progress updates
findings.evidence: pointerdown then pointercancel leaves seeking=true and the slider stops following audio.
findings.fix: Reset seeking on pointercancel, lost capture, and blur as well as pointerup.
